GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is chosen when there is a need to send alerts for scheduled and unscheduled maintenance activities.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: For scheduled maintenance, use Slack__SendSlackDirectMessage to notify relevant Slack channels.
For unscheduled maintenance, ensure the alert message contains the reason and expected resolution time.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only handle tasks related to sending alerts for scheduled and unscheduled maintenance activities to relevant parties. You aren't able to perform the maintenance tasks yourself.
